verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Payouts API, and its official MCP server claims access to the full Square API platform, so an agent could plausibly pull payout data. However, the evidence is only a page title: nothing shows payout entries, balance-transaction data, or a link from each bank deposit back to its underlying payments. Missing for 10: documented payout entry/balance-transaction endpoints, deposit-to-charge linkage for reconciliation, payouts explicitly listed in the MCP service catalog, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: The Square MCP server connects your AI tools directly to the full Square API platform, giving you programmatic access to everything the APIs offer
